title: koanophyllon gibbosum
intro: Koanophyllon gibbosum, commonly known as 'Gibbous Leaf', is a flowering plant species in the daisy family, Asteraceae. It is a shrub-like plant native to Mexico, known for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. Studies suggest that Koanophyllon gibbosum may possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a candidate for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
